title: UIAO Governance Metadata Schema
description: Canonical metadata contract for UIAO governance artifacts (canon/, playbooks/, appendices/). This schema documents the rules enforced by tools/metadata_validator.py. The validator currently hardcodes these rules and does not consume the schema at runtime; this schema is maintained as the single source of truth for the metadata contract so that (a) humans and tooling can read it, and (b) a future validator rewrite can switch to schema-driven validation without re-deriving the contract. Rules that are not purely JSON-Schema-expressible are documented under x-validator-rules.

document_id.description: Canonical artifact identifier. Substrate canon: UIAO_NNN (exactly three digits, tracked in document-registry.yaml). Foundational charter: CHARTER-NNN (or CHARTER-NNN-SUFFIX for related material; CHARTER-V3-LEGACY for the explicitly-superseded historical predecessor; tracked in charter-registry.yaml). See ADR-070 for the charter tier convention.

version.description: Semantic major.minor version (e.g., 1.0). Patch component is not used at the metadata layer.

status.description: Doc-workflow lifecycle state (Dimension 1). Not to be confused with classification (authority tier) or `lifecycle` (Dimension 2 page adoption state per ADR-082).

classification.description: Authority tier. CANONICAL = source of truth; DERIVED = generated from canonical source (requires provenance block); OPERATIONAL = runtime/process artifacts.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime prefix. Validator permits trailing precision/timezone suffixes.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime. Must be >= created_at (enforced by the validator via string comparison; see x-validator-rules.updated_at_monotonic).

boundary.description: Compliance boundary. Only GCC-Moderate is permitted unless boundary-exception is true (Amazon Connect Contact Center is the sole documented Commercial Cloud exception under the UIAO canon).

boundary-exception.description: Escape hatch for the boundary enum and the body-text boundary-violation scan. Use sparingly and document the justification in the body.

provenance.description: Required when classification == 'DERIVED'. Ties a derived artifact to its canonical source.

source.description: Path to the canonical source artifact. The validator verifies that this path resolves under the base path or its parent.

publish_to_site.description: Declares whether this document is intended for the published site at https://whalermike.github.io/uiao/. See ADR-068. When absent, scripts/scan_publication_gaps.py applies path-pattern defaults: true for src/uiao/canon/UIAO_*.md, src/uiao/canon/adr/adr-*.md, and src/uiao/modernization/**/*.md; false elsewhere.

publication_style.description: How the document should appear on the published site. Only meaningful when publish_to_site == true. See ADR-068. 'narrative' = hand-authored .qmd summary; 'include' = .qmd wrapper that {{< include >}}s the canon body verbatim; 'reference' = generated developer-reference rendering (e.g., schema property table).

lifecycle.description: Per ADR-082, page-lifecycle adoption state (Dimension 2; distinct from `status` which is Dimension 1 doc-workflow state). aspirational = canon-declared, not adopted at any tier. adopted = operationally adopted at one or more ADR-076 tiers (cite via tiers_adopted). superseded = replaced by successor (cite via superseded_by). deprecated = retiring (cite via deprecated_replacement). Banner rendered from this field by the {{< lifecycle-banner >}} Quarto shortcode (ADR-082 Phase 2).

tiers_adopted.description: Per ADR-082, list of ADR-076 conformance tier numbers at which the page's content is operationally adopted. Required when lifecycle == 'adopted'. Enforced by scripts/scan_lifecycle_consistency.py.

lifecycle_review.description: Per ADR-082, ISO 8601 date by which the lifecycle declaration must be re-validated. Past dates emit non-blocking advisories from scripts/scan_lifecycle_consistency.py.

superseded_by.description: Per ADR-082, repo-relative path to the successor page. Required when lifecycle == 'superseded'. Resolved by scripts/scan_lifecycle_consistency.py.

deprecated_replacement.description: Per ADR-082, optional repo-relative path to a replacement page when lifecycle == 'deprecated'.

x-validator-rules.description: Rules enforced by tools/metadata_validator.py and scripts/scan_lifecycle_consistency.py that are not purely JSON-Schema-expressible. Update this block if you modify the validators.
x-validator-rules.updated_at_monotonic: updated_at string comparison >= created_at string comparison; BLOCKING otherwise.
x-validator-rules.provenance_source_resolution: When classification == 'DERIVED', provenance.source must resolve to a path that exists under base_path or base_path.parent.
x-validator-rules.body_boundary_violations: Body text matching /GCC[\s-]?High|DoD|IL[456]|Azure\s+(IaaS|PaaS)|azure\.com/i is BLOCKING unless boundary-exception == true.
x-validator-rules.body_mermaid: Body containing a ```mermaid fenced block raises a WARNING (PlantUML is the preferred diagram format).
x-validator-rules.walker_skip: Files named INDEX.md and README.md are skipped by the directory walker and therefore exempt from metadata rules.
x-validator-rules.lifecycle_adopted_requires_tiers: When lifecycle == 'adopted', tiers_adopted must be non-empty. Enforced by scripts/scan_lifecycle_consistency.py (ADR-082 Phase 1).
x-validator-rules.lifecycle_superseded_requires_link: When lifecycle == 'superseded', superseded_by must be non-null and must resolve to an existing file. Enforced by scripts/scan_lifecycle_consistency.py (ADR-082 Phase 1).
x-validator-rules.lifecycle_tiers_range: Each tiers_adopted value must be in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] per ADR-076. Enforced by scripts/scan_lifecycle_consistency.py.
x-validator-rules.lifecycle_review_past_advisory: When lifecycle_review is in the past, scripts/scan_lifecycle_consistency.py emits a non-blocking advisory (not a failure).
